text:
maria: Quick sync 1 minute planning: we need a benchmark narrative thats obvious to engineers and catchy for social. Goal: 2 hero visuals, 1 animated micro-clip, single-page narrative PDF.

ajay: Proposal for hero visuals: 1) Cost curve: $/1M tokens vs QPS with lines for baseline, quantized, cached+batching. 2) Stability map: heatmap of P95 across seq_len x QPS. The heatmap gives a quick "safe operating region" POV.

sam: Love the heatmap idea. For social clip: animate a needle moving across the cost curve showing "choose your tradeoff". Keep it 6-8s.

jen: Messaging options to A/B test in paid: A) "Cut inference spend up to 60% without retooling" B) "Predictable tail latency as traffic scales" C) combo: "Lower cost, predictable latency". Keep CTA: "Run the benchmark on your workload".

eli: I'll draft the single-page narrative. Need a tiny table with assumed baseline numbers and deltas for copy. @ajay can you supply baseline vs rw-opt-8b quant/cached numbers?

ajay: Dropping sample numbers in channel now. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/bench-172660. Small sample: rw-opt-8b,64,62000,9.1,12,36,120; rw-opt-8b-q4_0,64,79000,6.8,14,40,140; rw-opt-8b-cached,64,98000,4.9,13,38,125

noah: SDR routing: leads that run the benchmark and indicate >100k monthly tokens -> route to AE/solutions. Add hidden field on the form: "expected_monthly_tokens" numeric.

jen: Social microcopy tested: "Cut your inference bill, not your SLA" and "Predictable P95 at burst traffic". Which resonates? We'll run the two variants in a small LinkedIn test.

maria: Design notes: use consistent axis ranges so cost comparisons are obvious. Cost curve annotations: label where caching provides the biggest marginal improvement (around 200-800 QPS). Use accessible colors.

sam: Webinar skeleton: 10m why it matters -> 12m live benchmark walkthrough (heatmap + cost curve) -> 8m customer example -> 10m Q&A. Target title: "Serving LLMs: predictable economics at scale".

eli: For the one-pager I'll include a 3-line TL;DR, 2 charts, key takeaways, and a single-step CTA (run benchmark). Draft due Tue EOD.

ajay: Small PR code snippet for docs/examples: 
```bash
# run a lightweight perf probe
curl -s https://api.redwood.com/v1/ping \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-opt-8b","seq_len":64,"batch":1}'
```

maria: Let's capture one quantitative claim in the headline but back it with a footnote:  "Up to 55% lower token cost vs stock runtime (median workloads)" with link to repo.

benchbot: Chart PNGs will be available after ajay uploads CSV-to-charts script. Pinging ajay for upload.

ajay: Uploaded csv + script to drive: /marketing/bench/172660_upload (will post links in the deck).

jen: I'll prepare two ad variants and the landing page copy. Landing page form fields: email, company, expected_monthly_tokens (hidden options: <10k,10-100k,100k+), consent checkbox.

maria: Cool. Action items: ajay = final csv + chart renders (Wed AM), eli = one-pager + slides (Wed EOD), jen = social ads + landing (Thu AM), sam = webinar ops + runbook (Thu EOD), noah = SDR routing rules (Thu EOD). Keep copy tight. :white_check_mark:

noah: I'll mock routing rules and demo the webhook mapping for leads >100k to the solutions queue.

eli: Will post a sneak preview of the one-pager tomorrow.

maria: Thanks all. Aim to have shareable assets for comms review by Friday.
